title: T06e — Independent review of the update path
goal: Review the merged journaled rehearsal and admission code together in a fresh context
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: A fresh-context review of the update path as merged (rehearse step, refused state, admission, forward-migration refusal, manual recovery text) reports blockers and gaps
Each finding gets a committed failing regression before its fix, or a recorded reason it is not a defect
validation: Review report under docs/reviews/; fixes with regressions; final required CI
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062

effort.basis: Owner-approved split of the original T06 (4–6 focused days) into lettered slices on 2026-11-11, after the work had been delivered as unplanned slices; slices e–h use free step numbers because step IDs are two digits. Assumes no blocker; a blocker adds its own fix effort, estimated when found. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.75 hours agent; one fresh-context review on the strongest model, reported in one PR. Method: NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge: median 0.56 h, p75 2.1 h, p90 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement) put a focused day at about 1.5 agent hours, with 0.75 h the least for one PR with review and CI. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.5 kept as history.
